description: Full-featured rich text editor with a comprehensive toolbar supporting headings (H1-H4), text formatting (bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, subscript, superscript), lists (ordered, unordered, task), indentation, links, images, tables, videos, code blocks, blockquotes, horizontal rules, text/highlight colors, emojis, find & replace, @mentions, and {{token}} variable insertion. Provides word count and character limit tracking. Token chips support visual differentiation via Icon, ColorClass, and TypeLabel. Hover over a token chip fires OnTokenHover so the application can display its own tooltip.

publicMethods.name: RefreshTokensAsync
publicMethods.description: Refreshes the token list from the provider. Calls Refresh() on the TokenProvider to invalidate its cache, then reloads tokens. Call this after creating or updating tokens so the autocomplete dropdown reflects the changes.

publicMethods.name: InsertTokenAsync

parameters.name: displayName
parameters.description: Text shown in the chip. Falls back to key if null.

publicMethods.description: Programmatically inserts a token chip into the editor at the current cursor position. Typically called from the parent component after the user creates a new token via OnTokenCreateRequested.

usedAbstractions.name: IToken
usedAbstractions.description: Interface representing a token/variable. Implement it to carry Icon, ColorClass, and TypeLabel for visual chip differentiation.

usedAbstractions.name: TokenHoverArgs
usedAbstractions.description: Event args passed to OnTokenHover. Contains token metadata and the chip's client bounding rect for tooltip positioning.

usedAbstractions.name: TmUser
usedAbstractions.description: Shared user model returned by ITmPeopleProvider for @mentions.

examples.title: Basic rich editor with two-way binding
Editor with mentions and tokens
examples.code:
<TmRichEditorFull @bind-Value="_content"
                  SupportsMentions="true"
                  MentionProvider="@mentionProvider"
                  SupportsTokens="true"
                  TokenProvider="@tokenProvider"
                  OnTokenCreateRequested="HandleCreateToken"
                  OnTokenInserted="HandleTokenInserted"
                  MaxLength="5000"
                  ShowWordCount="true" />
